summary: Execution validity under CPC s.47; section 47 objections permissible by subsequent purchasers; Order VIII Rules 1,5,10 CPC require single defendant; ex parte judgment against one defendant invalid without title determination; interim order not executable decree; section 52 Transfer of Property Act issue; contempt proceedings; High Court wrongly quashed revisional order; execution objections non-maintainable due to non-adjudication of title.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order VIII Rules 1, 5, 10
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order IX Rule 11
Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 s.229B
Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 s.331
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing revisional order set aside; execution objections declared non-maintainable; parties directed to seek title adjudication through appropriate proceedings.
